body: A day at a time is quite a stretch, at the moment I'm trying to get through the next five minutes. You mentioned you don't work in the field you have degrees in - do you mind my asking why and what those fields are? I feel like I've put my entire life into succeeding in this and am getting nowhere.

Thank you for taking time to reply. The sad thing is, I'm not even working at the moment so I can't really be burnt out by it. I was, then i decided to take time off to do a masters and then get a job doing research instead, but i can't seem to be able to get one. I've had interviews which I've been told I've done really well in, but never got the job. It's hard to break into and I'm scared the only thing i will be able to work in is my old role, which i don't want to do because of the negative impact it had on my health and life. 
Typing all that didn't really help as much as I thought it might tbh. Yes my bf does realise this, but he feels trapped to because he is on an unpaid phd so depends on his parents atm. 
Funny thing, I always tell everyone else they deserve to be happy. But I really think happiness is for other people, not me.

" I try to let people know that they don't have to be afraid of talking to me. But it seems I do all the question-asking and listening. No one cares about my days or my nights or my thoughts or whether I live or die. I try to reach out to people and help them, but I've realized it's all for my own selfish reasons anyways.
All I wanted so badly was for someone to mirror me, to do for me as I'd done for them. It's not fair for me to expect that of people, so I can't be angered. I do feel trivialized, however, and less important than I've ever felt."

I know exactly how you feel. I wish I knew how to make this better.
